title: Release eve 0.7.0
summary: Prepared eve 0.7.0 by promoting the unreleased changes since v0.6.0 into a dated changelog section and updating the published npm installer package metadata to version 0.7.0.
userVisibleChange: eve 0.7.0 packages idle CPU reductions, event-driven refresh behavior, context-first pull request review views, artifact rendering fixes, pull request Snapshot context fixes, and history-only Snapshot updates after branch merges.

risks.title: Deployment depends on remote GitHub Actions and npm secrets
risks.mitigation: Local verification passed; pushing tag v0.7.0 triggers the configured release workflow, whose final publish depends on repository secrets and Actions availability.

timeline.title: Locked release Plan
timeline.summary: Declared and locked the 0.7.0 release Plan before modifying release metadata.

timeline.title: Prepared release metadata
timeline.summary: Updated npm/eve package version and package lock to 0.7.0, and created the 2026-07-28 changelog section.

timeline.title: Ran local release verification
timeline.summary: Ran Go tests, version-injection test, npm installer tests and pack check, UI tests/build, and site build.

timeline.title: Prepared deployment trigger
timeline.summary: Committed release metadata in preparation for tagging v0.7.0 and pushing to origin.

decisions.title: Use the existing release script
decisions.rationale: scripts/prepare-release.sh updates npm package metadata and changelog structure consistently with prior releases.

decisions.title: Deploy via tag workflow
decisions.rationale: The repository release workflow publishes GitHub release assets and the npm installer when a v*.*.* tag is pushed.
